event_data.context: Observed while finishing verified-final-review enforcement: credible fixes were mixed with advisory performance and eval concerns, repeated full gates, immutable-pin checkpoint churn, and coordinator recovery. The workflow did not force an explicit proportionality checkpoint soon enough; the user had to interrupt. Address only after the current final-review enforcement ticket is delivered and development-system 5.4 is released.
event_data.summary: Prevent required lifecycle gates from driving disproportionate scope expansion or long uninterruptible loops after the material objective is satisfied.
event_data.title: Keep development workflow proportionate and interruptible
